# Socratink

> Make the thinking your own.

Talk through a hard idea with an AI tutor. See what you can explain on your own.

## How it works

- [Read your skill map](https://socratink.ai/#how-it-works). The tutor breaks your topic into skills and rates each from 0 to 5 based on your work in the conversation.
- [Talk an idea through](https://socratink.ai/#speak). You can type or dictate your reasoning, ask for a hint, or request a direct answer.
- [Return to a conversation](https://socratink.ai/#keep). Guest history stays with your guest session. Sign in to access your account history across devices.

## Links

- [Start learning](https://app.socratink.ai/) in your browser. You can start without an account.
- [Landing page](https://socratink.ai/)
